name: Admin Blog Overdue Schedule Safety-Net
description: Backend Huey periodic task scans BlogPost rows where publish_scheduled_for is in the past but the post is still unpublished, then publishes them automatically (and triggers the LinkedIn auto-publish if connected). The management command publish_blog_post.py is a manual escape hatch for the same logic. No browser interaction.
knownGaps: Backend-only safety-net for missed schedules. Covered by backend/content/tests/tasks/test_blog_publish_guards.py; no E2E spec applies.
